text:
Diagram 1 shows two identical lamps connected in series with a cell. Diagram 2 shows the same
two lamps connected in parallel with an identical cell.
diagram 1
diagram 2
Which statement is correct?
A
The cell in diagram 1 can supply current to the lamps for longer than the cell in diagram 2.
B
The current in the cell in diagram 1 is greater than the current in the cell in diagram 2.
C
The lamps in diagram 1 are brighter than the lamps in diagram 2.
D
The voltage across each lamp in diagram 1 is greater than the voltage in diagram 2.

options.label: A
options.text: The cell in diagram 1 can supply current to the lamps for longer than the cell in diagram 2.

options.label: B
options.text: The current in the cell in diagram 1 is greater than the current in the cell in diagram 2.

options.label: C
options.text: The lamps in diagram 1 are brighter than the lamps in diagram 2.

options.label: D
options.text: The voltage across each lamp in diagram 1 is greater than the voltage in diagram 2.
